rules.alternatives: Ongoing specialty board recertification (Maintenance of Certification) may fulfill the CME requirement; acceptable boards are listed in OAR 847-008-0070. Lifetime certification alone does not count. Emeritus status: 15 hours/year.
rules.audit_note: Cultural competency is audited every other renewal cycle (current audit period for most licensees 2024-2027, audited at the Fall 2027 renewal).

topics.who: Oregon Pain Management Commission course, at initial licensure and every two years
Average 1 hour per year licensed over the audit period (two renewal cycles)

rules.notes: Oregon titles PAs 'Physician Associate'. Board page lists 30 hours/year for active, locum tenens and telemedicine active PAs. Renewal is annual or biennial by license type. OAR text on secure.sos.state.or.us blocked to scripts; facts from the board page.
